description: A clean, refined contemporary office workspace photographed in a large open-plan commercial interior. The back wall is fully clad in warm light oak vertical slat paneling that rises from floor to ceiling in parallel narrow strips, creating strong texture and warmth against the otherwise minimal palette. Built-in open shelving with the same warm oak material occupies the right portion of the back wall, holding a sparse arrangement of white ceramic vases, globe decorative objects, and a few upright books. A single-stem tall plant in a pot provides greenery. The floor is smooth large-format light grey concrete or porcelain tile. The conference table is a large rectangular white laminate surface on white pedestal legs, attended by six ergonomic office chairs in warm greige fabric on black bases with wheeled casters. A mobile white pedestal filing cabinet sits beneath the table on the left side. The ceiling is flat white with minimal visible infrastructure. Through a full-height black-framed glass partition wall on the left, a secondary workspace is visible with additional white tables and chairs. Two slim matte black linear bar-form ceiling-hung elements extend horizontally above the table — one at mid-ground, one slightly closer — casting a clean strip of bright white-cool light downward onto the work surface below. The light from these elements reflects in a narrow linear band across the table surface. The overall atmosphere is calm, functional, and architecturally minimal — Scandinavian-influenced office aesthetic. Camera at standing eye-level, wide normal lens, three-quarter corner view showing the table, the back wall, and the glass partition. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
